verse.verse_1: HAS NEWS OF the Overpowering Event reached you?
verse.verse_2: Many faces will be contrite on that day,
verse.verse_5: Given water from the boiling spring to drink.
verse.verse_6: They will have no food except bitter thorn,
verse.verse_8: Many faces will be joyous on that day,
verse.verse_12: There is a stream of running water in it;
verse.verse_13: And within it are couches placed on high,
verse.verse_17: Do they not then ponder how the clouds were formed;
verse.verse_18: And the heavens, how it was raised high;
verse.verse_19: And the mountains, how they were fixed;
verse.verse_20: And the earth, how it was spread out?
verse.verse_21: Remind them; you are surely a reminder.
verse.verse_22: You are not a warden over them,
verse.verse_23: Other than him who turns his back and denies,
verse.verse_24: In which case he will be punished by God with the severest punishment.
verse.verse_25: To Us is surely their returning;
verse.verse_26: Ours is surely then to reckon with them.
